statement_summary: Security program; reasonable measures to protect CPNI benchmarked to CSF 2.0 and CISA CPGs
Named security lead, CPNI compliance officer, and CALEA senior officer; refile CALEA designation within 30 days of change
Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30
Annual independent control assessment supports the CPNI certification
Evidence-based annual CPNI certification by March 1
Sanctions for CPNI misuse, including vendor agents
No CPNI to a vendor without CPNI and security terms and a security review
Retention of CPNI approval, notice, campaign, and breach records
Unique accounts; named TACACS+ accounts for network elements
Least privilege; bulk export limited; scoped service accounts
MFA for all sensitive and network element administration; hardware keys for administrators
Same-day access removal and shared credential rotation at termination
Quarterly access reviews; monthly overflow vendor roster reconciliation
Management plane reachable only from jump hosts; isolated lawful-intercept path
Sealed break-glass console credentials
Change vendor default passwords and SNMP strings before connection
Customer authentication for phone, online, and in-person CPNI access; account change notices
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour to the NOC or IT
Security incident register doubles as the CPNI breach record
Meet CPNI breach, CALEA compromise, outage, and state notice deadlines
Annual incident response tabletop including NOC and regulatory staff
Whole customer account record protected to the CPNI standard
CPNI use only as 64.2005 allows; approval flag checked at time of use
Supervisory approval and register for CPNI campaigns; biennial opt-out notice
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Isolated immutable backups tested quarterly
CDR online retention 18 months; remove unneeded SSN digits and dates of birth
Annual awareness training for all staff including field technicians; phishing exercises
Annual CPNI training for everyone with CPNI access, including vendor agents
Look up accounts only for a job need; call detail views logged and reviewed
Approved generative AI tools only; no CPNI in unapproved tools
